exceptions.rationale: rsa is present in Cargo.lock through optional sqlx-mysql, which is not compiled by this PostgreSQL-only workspace.
exceptions.compensating_control: every_uncompiled_exception_is_uncompiled fails as soon as rsa enters the build graph, so enabling MySQL cannot happen with this exception still in place.

exceptions.rationale: A CVE in the SQLite that libsqlite3-sys bundles. The crate is present in Cargo.lock only through optional sqlx-sqlite, which this PostgreSQL-only workspace does not compile; the fix (0.39) needs a newer sqlx major.
exceptions.compensating_control: every_uncompiled_exception_is_uncompiled fails as soon as libsqlite3-sys enters the build graph, so enabling SQLite cannot happen with this exception still in place.

exceptions.rationale: Unmaintained parser reached through serde_yaml, which capsulet-runner and capsulet-worker use to read the execution pool configuration an operator writes, and which kube-client uses to read kubeconfig; the advisory reports no exploitable defect.
exceptions.compensating_control: Never parse YAML from a request or a run with it. New vulnerability findings are not covered by this maintenance exception. Replacing serde_yaml in the workspace alone would not remove it while kube-client depends on it, so review kube's YAML dependency before this expires.

exceptions.rationale: Unit-test bearer tokens (0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef and its rotation) that AuthConfig's tests parse and authenticate; they were never credentials for any deployment. The fingerprints name the two commits that added them, so this entry covers those occurrences and nothing a later commit adds.
exceptions.compensating_control: The secrets gate scans the whole history in CI and fails on any finding that is not one of these fingerprints, or when one of them stops being found. Deployed tokens are generated per stack or per install and never committed.
